sn55.42:1.1: cattāro me bhikkhave, puññābhisandā, kusalābhisandā, sukhassāhārā.
sn55.42:1.3: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.42:1.4: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.42:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, ariyasāvako vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato.
sn55.42:3.3: ime kho bhikkhave, cattāro puññābhisandā, kusalābhisandā, sukhassāhārā.
sn55.42:4.1: imehi kho bhikkhave, catūhi puññābhisandehi kusalābhisandehi samannāgatassa ariyasāvakassa na sukaraṃ puññassa pamāṇaṃ gaṇetuṃ.
sn55.42:4.3: atha kho “asaṅkheyyo appamyeyyo mahāpuññakkhandho”tveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn55.42:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, yatthimā mahānadiyo saṃsandanti samenti. seyyathidaṃ:
sn55.42:5.2: gaṅgā, yamunā, aciravatī, sarabhū, mahī. tattha na sukaraṃ udakassa pamāṇaṃ gaṇetuṃ,
sn55.42:5.3: “ettakāni udakāḷhakānīti vā ettakāni udakāḷhakasatānīti vā ettakāni udakāḷhakasahassānīti vā ettakāni udakāḷhakasatasahassānīti vā”.
sn55.42:5.4: atha kho “asaṅkheyyo appameyyo mahāudakakkhandho” tveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
sn55.42:5.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, imehi catūhi puññābhisandehi kusalābhisandehi samannāgatassa ariyasāvakassa na sukaraṃ puññassa pamāṇaṃ gaṇetuṃ:
sn55.42:5.7: atha kho “asaṅkheyyo appameyyo mahāpuññakkhandho” tveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
